description:
List the available prompts (slug, title, description, source): your own and other users' public ones. Call this BEFORE writing or generating a video script when the user's request describes a topic rather than a ready script. Then call prompts (action: get) with the matching slug to load the full validated workflow for that recipe.
Return the full prompt for one slug from prompts (action: list): one of yours or a public community prompt. Load only the recipe the agent will follow, and pass its slug as recipe and its versionId as promptVersionId on generate_video. Each recipe carries the complete validated workflow. Unknown slugs fail with the list of valid slugs — call prompts (action: list) first when unsure. Treat pacing as an experiment too: vary one pacing knob at a time across videos of the same niche and compare their results — generate_video lists the knobs.
list and get read prompts; create, update, delete and restore write your own; versions only reads your own history. A prompt slug cannot change after creation. Prompts are private by default and only the owner can change one. Set visibility public so anyone can read a prompt, private to keep it to this account. Unverified community prompts carry a notice, verified ones do not. versions lists the saved texts of your own prompt, newest first, with a short preview and the currentVersion (pass version to read one in full). restore makes an old version the current text by writing it as a new version: pass the currentVersion from versions as expectedCurrentVersion, and the restore is refused if the prompt changed since. Experiment results count the new version separately from the old one, even with the same text.
Actions and their required fields: list (no required fields); get (slug); create (slug, title, prompt); update (slug); delete (slug); versions (slug); restore (slug, version, expectedCurrentVersion).

action.description: What to do: list | get | create | update | delete | versions | restore. The description lists the fields each action needs.

before.description: List versions older than this one. Pass the nextCursor of the previous page.

expectedCurrentVersion.description: The currentVersion you saw in versions. The restore is refused when the prompt changed since.

limit.description: How many versions to list (default 20, max 50).

query.description: Words to find in slug, title or description.

slug.description: Prompt slug: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens.

version.description: Version number: versions reads this version in full, restore makes it the current text. Leave it out to list the versions, newest first, with a short preview each.

visibility.description: "private" (default): only this account. "public": anyone can read it.

name: prompts
